# v0.1 exploration: 78 core foods (generated by `src/analysis/explore.py`)
Data: `data/processed/foods_master.csv` (prices 2026-10-06: CSP 12-month means + Cenu Depo snapshot). Useful protein = protein × min(DIAAS, 100)/100 (adult pattern) unless stated. **Descriptive results, not recommendations**: no constraints, no diet context (that is v1.0).

- **Useful protein density (eaten)** (g/100 g): Chicken breast fillet 31.0, Turkey breast fillet 30.1, Beef (bone-in) 29.5, Ground beef 28.9, Beef steak (lean) 27.3

## 3. Pareto fronts (foods no other core food beats on both axes)
- Useful protein density (eaten) × Energy density (eaten): Walnuts, Hazelnuts, Peanut butter, Peanuts, Hard cheese, Minced mixed meat, Minced pork, Beef (bone-in), Chicken breast fillet
- Useful protein per euro × Calories per euro: Split peas
- Useful protein per euro × Carbohydrate per euro: Split peas
- Useful protein per 1000 kcal × Calories per euro: Split peas, Grey peas, Chickpeas (dry), Dried beans, Milk, Minced pork, Whole chicken, Chicken legs (bone-in), Textured soy protein, Chicken breast fillet, Turkey breast fillet, Frozen cod/pollock fillet
- Calories per euro × Food mass for 1000 kcal (eaten): Walnuts, Peanut butter, Peanuts, Pasta, White rice, Grey peas, Split peas
- 4-D front (Calories per euro, Useful protein per euro, Energy density (eaten), Food mass for 1000 kcal (eaten)): White rice, Pasta, Split peas, Grey peas, Chickpeas (dry), Chicken legs (bone-in), Whole chicken, Minced pork, Peanuts, Peanut butter, Walnuts

- **Cluster 3** (6): Cornflakes, Bananas, Apples, Raisins, Cabbage, Carrots
- **Cluster 4** (25): White rice, Brown rice, Rolled oats, Buckwheat groats, Barley groats / pearl barley, Semolina, Millet, Bulgur, Couscous, Pasta, Muesli, Rye bread (rupjmaize), Fine rye bread (saldskābmaize), Rye-wheat bread, White wheat bread, Wholegrain bread, Toast bread, Crispbread, Potatoes, Dried beans, Red lentils, Green/brown lentils, Split peas, Grey peas, Chickpeas (dry)
- **Cluster 5** (25): Tofu (firm), Chicken breast fillet, Chicken legs (bone-in), Whole chicken, Chicken thigh fillet, Turkey breast fillet, Pork (boneless), Pork (bone-in), Minced pork, Minced mixed meat, Ground beef, Beef (bone-in), Beef steak (lean), Canned stewed meat, Smoked chicken, Salmon fillet, Frozen cod/pollock fillet, Frozen fish fillet, Smoked mackerel, Sprats in oil (šprotes), Canned tuna in water, Carp, Eggs, Hard cheese, Processed cheese

## 8. Caveats
- Prices: CSP (official means) and Cenu Depo (≈10 % lower on cross-checked foods) are mixed; a price-source sensitivity run is planned (PLAN D.1).
- Grade C digestibility proxies (fish, nuts, buckwheat, …) and grade C composition (stewed meat, curd snack, pelmeņi) are included; see `foods_master.csv` grades.
- Food-level 'useful protein' ignores complementarity between foods; diet-level amino-acid constraints come in v1.0 (decision D9).
